subject: Pricing alignment & contract narrowing for DataPulse migration
messages:
From: Hannah White <h.white@datapulse.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: DataPulse Procurement <procurement@datapulse.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing alignment and packaging options

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the routing controls. We're evaluating a potential migration off CloudScale and we're trying to understand if Redwood can match the economics they offered. High level: current spend is ~ $45k/month, primarily for text-generation (approx 420M tokens / month) with occasional spikes for batch jobs.

Our procurement asks:
- Can Redwood match CloudScale's effective blended rate for committed usage?
- If not an exact match, what migration credits and packaging would you offer to make the TCO comparable?
- We need a clear path to a pilot + production cutover within 8-10 weeks.

I've attached our anonymized usage telemetry to make the ask concrete (datapulse-usage-telemetry.csv). Procurement is on copy (procurement@datapulse.com).

Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Hannah White
Head of Platform, DataPulse
H: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: datapulse-usage-telemetry.csv (CSV, 78KB)

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah White <h.white@datapulse.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options

Hannah — appreciate the usage file, that helps a lot. Quick responses to your asks: 

1) Matching: we can come close to CloudScale on blended unit economics with a firm 12-month commit + reserved capacity, but I need to confirm exact numbers with finance.

2) Migration credits: we're open to a one-time onboarding credit; the size depends on the committed baseline and whether you need a dedicated pool.

3) Timeline: an 8-week pilot into production is feasible.

Before I put numbers on paper, could you confirm:
- Avg and peak tokens per hour (not just monthly), especially any daily 95th percentile spikes?
- Whether you require a VPC/private deployment or are ok with hosted+dedicated?
- Who will sign the SOW (name/email) so we can loop Legal/Finance earlier.

I'm attaching a working pricing spreadsheet (redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.xlsx) so you can see levers (committed tokens, reserved GPU pool, pilot credits). Jordan (cc) is on deck to price a dedicated pool if you need one.

If it helps, we can propose two parallel options: a) conservative match with modest migration credit; b) aggressive match with a larger migration credit tied to a 12-month commitment and minimum committed tokens. Which do you prefer us to prioritize?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/marcus

Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: Hannah White <h.white@datapulse.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: DataPulse Procurement <procurement@datapulse.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 18:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options

Marcus — thanks. A few specifics to make options concrete:

- Typical weekday baseline: ~18M tokens/day (~540M tokens/month if you use 30d), nightly batch jobs bring spikes of ~60M tokens over 1–2 hours about twice a week. Peak hourly P95 ~ 8–9M tokens.
- We prefer a hosted+dedicated arrangement for isolation but are open to a VPC if Redwood recommends it from an SLA standpoint.
- Procurement lead: Lina Gomez <l.gomez@datapulse.com>. She handles SOW and procurement.

Commercial preference: prioritize the aggressive match (option b) if you can structure migration credits to cover professional services and egress risk. We can lock a 12-month commitment with a 6-month ramp to full committed volume.

If you can sketch the aggressive option (numbers and migration credit sizing), Lina wants to review and then we'll route to legal.

Hannah

(On the procurement side: procurement@datapulse.com)

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah White <h.white@datapulse.com>; marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options — proposed bundle

Hi Hannah — I'm Monica from Solutions (cc Jordan for engineering handoff). Quick technical/commercial proposal to make the aggressive match real while protecting both sides: 

Proposal (aggressive match path):
- Pilot: 6-week pilot (hosted + reserved GPUs) with a $10k pilot credit (covers infra + PS).
- Commit: 12-month term, committed baseline set at 500M tokens/month; 6-month linear ramp from 50%->100% of committed tokens.
- Discount: 18% across generation unit pricing once committed baseline is reached.
- Migration credit: one-time credit equal to 100% of the first month of committed spend (applied as invoice credit after go-live).
- Dedicated pool: optional dedicated GPU pool add-on (recommended for isolation at scale) — can be priced as a fixed monthly fee.
- SLA/rollback: canary rollout with automatic fallback to hosted fallback model; service credits for SLO misses.

Attachments: migration-plan-summary.pdf (2 pages) — outlines the 6-week pilot milestones, cutover checklist, and rollback plan.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Lina (procurement) to confirm SOW signatory and any mandatory clauses.
2) I'll hand the migration plan to our Solutions Architects to draft a brief PS statement of work.
3) Marcus will finalize commercial numbers and send an LOI/DocuSign for signatures.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call with Lina and your engineering lead if you want to walk through the pilot plan.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 212-555-0432

Attachment: migration-plan-summary.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah White <h.white@datapulse.com>, Lina Gomez <l.gomez@datapulse.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com, cs@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment & contract narrowing for DataPulse migration

Hannah / Lina —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming traffic patterns. Based on Monica's proposal, finance has approved the aggressive match path with the following concrete commercial terms: 

- 12-month term, committed baseline: 500M tokens/month (6-month ramp).
- Effective discount: 18% off list generation rate after committed baseline reached.
- Migration credit: equal to one month's committed spend (applied as invoice credit post-go-live).
- Pilot: 6-week pilot with $10k pilot credit, included professional services estimate of ~40 hours for migration support.
- Dedicated pool: optional — quoted separately as a fixed monthly fee; we can include it in the SOW if you confirm.

Lina — I'll send a short LOI and a DocuSign for the commitment and SOW acceptance by EOD tomorrow. Once signed, Monica and Jordan will schedule the kickoff and Solutions will own the 6-week pilot plan.

If either of you want to adjust the migration credit mechanics (e.g., split across invoices vs. one-time), we can accommodate that in the SOW.

On a related note: \"On Wed, Sep 15, 2027 at 10:15 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:\"
